{{Quote|These flavorful sliders are inspired by my travels across the galaxy, so no matter what your tastes are, you're sure to find something to satisfy your craving! All sliders are served with our special garnish. Sernpidalian mayo-ketchup and Bimm mustard available upon request.|The Dex's Diner menu|<ref name="Menu" />}}
'''Bimm mustard''' was a type of [[Mustard/Legends|mustard]]<ref name="Menu" /> that shared its name with two [[Species/Legends|species]], one [[Bimm (furred species)/Legends|furred]] and the other [[Bimm/Legends|Near-Human]].<ref name="P&M">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> The [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] enjoyed the taste of the mustard and used it in [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], his [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="Menu" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> It would be served upon request alongside any [[slider]] on the menu.<ref name="Menu" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bimm mustard is mentioned in a [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]]-exclusive release, "[[Dining at Dex's]]" by [[Gregory Walker]], which represents the [[in-universe]] menu of Dex's Diner.<ref name="Menu" />
